absent-directory.summary: Declared directories not on disk and not declared `absent`: a consumer scanning them finds nothing and may report a clean run.

long-description.summary: Declared directories whose description runs over 60 words: shown to readers under the README heading, so history and argument belong in a `_comment` instead.

no-description.summary: Declared directories with no `description`: their README says so instead of saying what they hold.

no-title.summary: Declared directories with no `title`: their README heading falls back to the id.

unmarked-readme.summary: READMEs that exist without the kg:subgraph markers, left untouched because somebody wrote them. Add the marker pair to adopt the generated section.

unresolved-process.summary: Directories whose `coverage.process` names a diagram no instance declares: the README says `could not determine` in place of the drawing. Declaring none is not here — a directory owes no process, and only a declaration that points at nothing is a finding.
